answer: Locks are recorded in terrace, expire in oasis, and falcon lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 26 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An hostile operator running 134 aliases therefore needs 70 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4610 identities would post 1280 proofs and burn roughly 13 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
